Found 62 items in registries @whiskeyjack:

Showing items 1-62 of 62:

- action-pill (registry:ui) - Toolbar pill of icon actions that collapse and grow as the page's context changes. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- app-panes (registry:ui) - The three-phase content row below a floating header: optional left sidebar, main region, optional right rail, each gated on the layout variants. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- app-shell (registry:ui) - The app layout skeleton: a fixed-height shell or a document scroller, with a frosted header, nav pills, and the main scroll region. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:ui) - Tone-tinted pill label on the semantic color scales, for status and classification at a glance. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- beam (registry:ui) - A travelling light around an element's edge, for the one thing on a screen that needs the eye. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- bottom-drawer (registry:ui) - Bottom sheet on mobile, centered dialog on desktop. Swipe, backdrop, Escape, and hardware Back all dismiss it. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- bottom-nav (registry:ui) - Pill-shaped frosted bottom navigation, hand-composed from BottomNavItem and BottomNavAction. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button-row (registry:ui) - Side-by-side buttons that share a row and stack full-width when they no longer fit. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:ui) - The action button. Labels wrap to two lines rather than overflowing, so long translated text stays inside the pill. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- calendar-heatmap (registry:ui) - GitHub-contributions-style activity heatmap, in squares or check-in dots. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card (registry:ui) - The elevated surface primitive, with header, title, description, content, and footer slots. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkbox-group (registry:ui) - Pick-any tile grid: the multi-select counterpart to ToggleGroup. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkbox (registry:ui) - A single checkbox, with the mixed state a parent selection needs. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- color-input (registry:ui) - Focusable swatch button that opens the OS-native color picker and returns the chosen hex. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- confirm-button (registry:ui) - Tap-again-to-confirm button for a destructive or disruptive action, with the armed state announced to assistive tech. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- disclosure-toggle (registry:ui) - Caret-and-label text button that expands and collapses an adjacent region, with aria-expanded and the touch and focus floors built in. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- drawer-action (registry:ui) - A single action in a BottomDrawer footer: plain, form-submit, or tap-again-confirm. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- empty-state (registry:ui) - Centered icon tile, title, subtitle, and optional call to action for an empty list or a fresh install. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- header-stand-in (registry:ui) - Header copy of a field whose primary lives in a scroller: grows in while the primary is scrolled away, collapses when it returns. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input (registry:ui) - Labeled text field that wires a real label to the input for you, with an optional hint, error and password reveal. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mobile-bottom-nav (registry:ui) - Data-driven bottom nav that collapses its items into a hamburger menu when they and the toolbar would overflow the viewport. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- notice (registry:ui) - Inline tone-tinted status box for context-bound messages, with each tone setting its own ARIA live-region role. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- page-title-context (registry:ui) - React context that lets any page set the desktop header title. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- progress-bar (registry:ui) - The accent progress primitive: determinate fill, busy sweep, open-ended indicator, or segment accumulation against a tally. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pull-to-refresh-indicator (registry:ui) - Frosted pill and spinner that slides down as you pull; the visual companion to usePullToRefresh. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reorder-list (registry:ui) - Drag-to-reorder list with an accessible arrow-button fallback, so it works by pointer, touch, and keyboard. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-indicator (registry:ui) - Read-only auto-hiding scroll thumb for scrollers whose native scrollbar would run behind floating chrome. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- search-field (registry:ui) - Search pill: a rounded-full text input with a leading magnifier and a trailing clear button. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- segmented-control (registry:ui) - Compact pick-one control: one bordered strip, divided into segments. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- select (registry:ui) - Styled native select for a one-of-n choice with more options than a segmented control can show. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-tabs (registry:ui) - TabBar's wide-layout counterpart: a vertical tab rail for a desktop sidebar, with each item's progress pinned to its bottom edge. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- slider (registry:ui) - Range input with an optional mono value readout beside its label. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tab-bar (registry:ui) - Metro-style pivot tabs with a sliding accent underline that doubles as each tab's progress bar. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- textarea (registry:ui) - Multi-line field with an optional character readout and auto-grow. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toast (registry:ui) - Floating notification pill fixed below the header, for app-level messages and background work. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toggle-group (registry:ui) - Segmented tile control for one-of-n choices, such as a light / dark / system theme picker. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toggle (registry:ui) - Switch control with a label and optional description, for a single on/off setting. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- accent-foreground (registry:lib) - Retint the whole UI from one accent color, with a WCAG-legible foreground picked automatically. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- announce (registry:lib) - Announce a message to assistive technology through a shared live region. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- compact-control (registry:lib) - The geometry of a compact control: a small pill, chip or segment that sits on a line with body text. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- direction (registry:lib) - Detect right-to-left direction for JS-driven interactions that CSS cannot reach. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- material-you (registry:lib) - Map Android's wallpaper-derived Material You palette onto the design-system surface and accent tokens. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- merge-refs (registry:lib) - Combine an internal ref with a forwarded one. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- option-tile (registry:lib) - The selectable-tile class recipe shared by ToggleGroup and CheckboxGroup. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-drag-reorder (registry:hook) - Drag-to-reorder list logic with an accessible keyboard path, behind ReorderList. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-focus-trap (registry:hook) - Trap focus inside an overlay while it is open, and restore it to the trigger on close. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-input-type (registry:hook) - Detect touch versus mouse input, for controls that phrase or size themselves differently. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-layout-gate (registry:hook) - Read the wide / xlwide layout gates in JS, for a decision CSS cannot express. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-nav-reset (registry:hook) - Double-tap the nav item for the page you are already on to bring the top and the active tab back into view, then to go to the page's start. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-pull-to-refresh (registry:hook) - Touch pull-to-refresh that coexists with tab swipes and overscroll-behavior: none. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-reduced-motion (registry:hook) - Respect the user's reduced-motion preference in JS-driven motion. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-route-focus (registry:hook) - Move focus to the main content on route change, so keyboard and screen-reader users land in the new page. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-scroll-fade (registry:hook) - Vertical edge-fade masks for a height-capped scrollable panel; returns the CSS class to apply. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-scroll-indicator (registry:hook) - Scroll metrics (thumb size, position, visibility) that drive ScrollIndicator. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-scroll-region (registry:hook) - Scroll the app's real scroll region – to the top on a first visit, back to where you left it on a return – whichever scroller the Layout chose. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-sliding-indicator (registry:hook) - Measures the active item in a tab-like container so one element can animate between items instead of the highlight jumping. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-stand-in-target (registry:hook) - Watches a field's primary instance and reports when it scrolls out of view, so a HeaderStandIn can speak for it. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-swipe-navigation (registry:hook) - Swipe between tabs with an axis-locked touch gesture that flips direction under RTL. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-tab-bar-fade (registry:hook) - Edge-fade masks for a horizontally overflowing tab strip; returns the CSS class to apply. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-theme (registry:hook) - The theme engine: light, dark, system, and OLED, with persistence and theme-color meta kept in sync. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-travel-direction (registry:hook) - Names which way a sliding indicator is travelling, so each of its edges can take its own easing. [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- utils (registry:lib) - Tailwind class merging (clsx plus tailwind-merge). [@whiskeyjack] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
